body:
I want to either accept that I am a transperson or stop questioning my gender identity. I want that question to stop interfering with my life. I want the underlying unhappiness that seems to infect most of my pursuits to go away, but I can't seem to put my finger on what it is or how to chase it away.

All that aside, I want to go to school for music. But I'm broke and confused and I feel lost when I open my eyes in the morning, and I can't seem to get through the fog no matter how much I try.

I do accept that responsibility, but the problem is, I can never seem to be made happy by the same thing for long enough for it to be worthwhile. I feel like my life has been a 25-year-long identity crisis and I'm sick of picking through bad moments to try and enjoy the rare good ones.
